LAB 5: GAS STOICHIOMETRY (Ben's sections)
Purpose: To determine the molar volume of hydrogen gas produced by reacting magnesium with hydrochloric acid.
Procedure: A 0.0350 g strip of magnesium was placed in a eudiometer containing 10 mL of 6 M HCl...
Conclusion: The experimental molar volume of H2 at STP was found to be 23.1 L/mol, which is close to the accepted 22.4 L/mol.
